name: Newmarket (July Course), draft
status: DRAFT, second version (after the owner's sketch), 8 Nov 2026: not used by the game yet
_about: Built by tools/course/newmarket/site_plan.py with july_layout.py. Interpretive, not surveyed: every number is a named choice in july_layout.py.
axes: Origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the straight horses run towards -x, inside rail z = 0 on their right, the track to z = trackWidth on their left. The stands are behind the inside rail (z < 0); the far side (z > trackWidth) faces the Rowley Mile across the Dyke.
compass: owner's sketch, 8 Nov: in courses/newmarket-site.json north is at the bottom of the plans (+z north, +x west)
site: Placed beside the Rowley Mile in courses/newmarket-site.json (rotation and offset into the Rowley Mile's axes).
direction: clockwise (right-handed: one bend, from the Cesarewitch leg into the July straight)

straight.note: the Bunbury Mile: races up to a mile are run straight

path.note: For the race engine: each bend as [metres to go where it starts, where it ends, degrees turned]; 'home' = where the home straight starts.

heights.note: The ground's height (m, against the post) every 'spacing' metres to go from 'from', along the inside rail: what the race engine reads (owner, 8 Nov: the dips and the climb count).

insideRail.fields: x, z, height, metres to go

profile.note: the owner's notes: rolling for the first three-quarters of the straight, downhill 6f to 5f out, a steep sustained climb over the last 2f

stands.name: Grandstand
stands.note: the winning line in front of it

stands.name: Judge's box stand
stands.note: the red judge's box tower on its roof

lawn.note: the lawns between the stands and the rail, packed, coloured umbrellas

festival.note: stand-side festival pieces from the end of the stands to 3.5f out: food and drink stalls, bars, umbrellas, picnic lawns; 10 m back from the rail, leaving a lane for the tracking car; a few shade trees

paddock.note: behind the stands: the parade rings and buildings among trees (barely seen)

farSide.side: beyond the outer rail: 'off' = metres beyond it

festival.note: marquees and pavilions among the trees, opposite the stands and past the post

crowd.note: the crowd in front of them, along the far rail

tier.name: Tiered stand
tier.note: behind the finish as the stand camera sees it: open tiers facing the track, opposite the line

dykeFace.note: Owner, 8 Nov: the Dyke on the far side, opposite the grandstands; set back behind the far-side festival near the finish. Offsets beyond the outer rail. 'line': metres to go, the crest's x and z, its height.

boards.fields: x, z, turn (degrees anticlockwise from above; 0 = facing +z), design

trees.fields: x, z, tree (as ascot-planting.json), scale, turn
